title: Travel platform data schema
description: Generated by node core/bin/schema.ts generate from core/src/schema. Do not edit by hand.

x-rules.describe: id is lg- plus the first 10 hex digits of SHA-256 of from_id|to_id|mode
opens_kind rolling-lead needs opens_lead_days
positions run 1..n per collection
t_s and d_m have one entry per decoded polyline vertex
every night is covered by exactly one base
n runs 0..N or 1..N without gaps
end - start + 1 equals the number of days with n >= 1
at most one edition is chosen or booked
seq is 1..n per day and track
trail items name a trail, checkin and checkout items name a base, at most one of trail, activity, eatery, custom item
start excludes a window, and window_end is not before window_start
plan_b_item_id names a track P item on the same day
cost amount, currency and cost_per go together
budget target amount and currency go together
path (and sidecar) exist under the repository
every id in a src column is in sources
slug pattern, not reserved, equals the root id and the folder name
duration_shape matches nights
nights equals the sum of bases.nights
primary_style also appears in trip_tags
web_published is false on a private trip
a booking names an offer, or an item and a category
price paid amount and currency go together
